The image features two large, curved metal moldboards (shares) in the foreground, showing signs of wear and soil residue. To the right, a large, treaded tractor tire is visible. In the background, the dark chassis and hitch mechanism of the tractor connect to the plow frame. The setting appears to be a field with dry grass or stubble.
